checks.task_description: Agent researches US labor market indicators from BLS/FRED, downloads data, bookmarks in 'Labor Market Data' folder, writes briefing

data_source: Real US government data portals: BLS.gov, FRED (St. Louis Fed), Census.gov
adversarial_robustness: Baseline download count recorded; only NEW downloads after task start credited. Bookmark folder must be newly created.
notes: Very hard: agent must know which government sites have authoritative labor statistics, how to find/download data files, how to create a bookmark folder
